name: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
aliases: E471, mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids, glyceryl monostearate, glyceryl monopalmitate, glyceryl monooleate, monostearin, monopalmitin, monoolein, GMS, mono- y diglicéridos de ácidos grasos
what_is: A widely used food emulsifier made of mixtures of glycerol mono-, di- and triesters of fatty acids.
why_botia: It flags it because it can be produced from either vegetable or animal fats, making its halal status doubtful (mashbooh) without certification.
can_1: Confirm the presence of E471 or its common industrial synonyms on the label.
can_2: Activate texture, animal, and Muslim choice layers due to its multiple functions and origins.
cannot_1: Confirm whether the fatty acids used were derived from animal (including porcine) or vegetable fats.
cannot_2: Determine the exact ratio of monoglycerides to diglycerides in the food matrix.

sources.label: OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 General Requirements on Halal Food
